findings.evidence: In the diff, `section Monoid` opens with `variable {G X : Type*} [Monoid G] [MulAction G X] {n : ℕ}`, and these lemmas appear before `variable [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace X]`. `ActionCategory/Basic.lean` already exists as the algebraic home for `ActionCategory` facts; it imports `Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Action` and no topology.
findings.fix: Create `TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Groupoid/ActionCategory/Nerve.lean` and move these lemmas there as public declarations. Also move the bare-equivalence parts of `nerveHomeomorph` (its toFun/invFun and the left/right inverse proofs). The Topology file should import the new file and keep only the continuity results and the homeomorphism.
findings.issue: `nerve_ext`, together with the private helpers it rests on (`hom_map_homOfLE_refl`, `hom_map_homOfLE_succ`, `back_obj`, `le_induction`) and `hom_map_mkOfObjOfMapSucc`, needs no topology. These lemmas come before `variable [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace X]` and assume only `[Monoid G] [MulAction G X]`, yet they sit in a Topology file. Anything that only needs these algebraic facts about strings (e.g. later smooth-structure work on nerve levels) would have to import the topological action-groupoid stack to get them. Making the helpers `private` does not fix where they live.

findings.evidence: It comes before the second `variable [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace X]` in `section Group`, and its proof uses only `back_obj` and `MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient.quotient_smul_eq`.
findings.fix: Move it to the same `TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Groupoid/ActionCategory/Nerve.lean`. `coarseAugmentation` and the later declarations can stay where they are.
findings.issue: `quotient_mk_back_obj` is another instance of the same problem. It says all points of a string lie in one orbit, and assumes only `[Group G] [MulAction G X]`, yet it sits in the Topology file.

summary: `TauCeti/Topology/CategoryTheory/ActionGroupoid/Nerve.lean` mixes in purely algebraic facts about strings of composable arrows in `ActionCategory G X`, including the public `nerve_ext` and `quotient_mk_back_obj`; they need no topology and belong under `TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Groupoid/ActionCategory/`. The rest of the placement and imports is fine: `eqToHom_hom` went to the right file, the generic `Topology/CategoryTheory/Nerve.lean` and the `ActionGroupoid/` subdirectory are appropriate homes, and the `Fin.partialProd` and `Quiver.Total` imports are both used.
